earnings.title: RALPH LAUREN REPORTS SECOND QUARTER FISCAL 2027 RESULTS AHEAD OF EXPECTATIONS AND RAISES FISCAL 2027 OUTLOOK
highlights: Second Quarter Revenue Increased 9% on a Reported Basis and 10% in Constant Currency, Exceeding Expectations, with Every Region Contributing to Growth led by Asia
China revenue increased more than 35% on both a reported and constant currency basis, driven by continued growth in comparable store sales along with new distribution expansion
In the second quarter of Fiscal 2027, revenue increased 9% to $2.2 billion on a reported basis and was up 10% in constant currency.
Global Direct-to-Consumer Comparable Store Sales Increased 10%, with Balanced Growth Across Digital and Brick-and-Mortar Channels with 9% Average Unit Retail ("AUR") Growth
Returned More Than $600 Million to Shareholders Through Our Dividend and Repurchase of Class A Common Stock This Fiscal Year-to-Date

quotes.text: As we enter the Holiday season, I'm reminded of what has always inspired me — the beauty of the world around us, the warmth of family and the optimism and sense of possibility that have guided us for nearly 60 years.
quotes.by: Ralph Lauren, Executive Chairman and Chief Creative Officer

quotes.text: We delivered strong second quarter performance, enabling us to raise our Fiscal 2027 outlook once again.
quotes.by: Patrice Louvet, President and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: In the second quarter of Fiscal 2027, the Company had an effective tax rate of approximately 20% on a reported basis and 19% on an adjusted basis, in-line with its outlook.

items.heading: Economic, political, and other conditions, including the imposition of significant new tariffs or other changes to existing trade policies and agreements, may adversely affect the global economy and/or the level of consumer purchases of discretionary items and luxury retail products, including our products.
Economic conditions could have a negative impact on our major customers, suppliers, vendors, and lenders, which in turn could materially adversely affect our business.
Our business is exposed to domestic and foreign currency fluctuations.
Infectious disease outbreaks could have a material adverse effect on our business.
We may not be successful in the expansion of our multi-channel distribution network or accelerating growth in certain product categories.

The success of our business depends on our ability to respond to constantly changing fashion and retail trends and consumer preferences in a timely manner, develop products that resonate with our existing customers and attract new customers, and provide a seamless shopping experience to our customers.
